result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on theta functions with a cube-root-of-unity (ρ) symmetry: the period variables are decomposed into three combinations w, w′, w″, the transformation of the theta series and its argument shifts are computed, and a period table is sketched with a reduction of the theta series by the coefficients b_k.
